# Eros Inc.

> Building Buzz. Scaling Brands. Compete With Compassion.

Eros Inc. is a dynamic growth-driven company dedicated to helping businesses build meaningful connections with their customers through innovative marketing solutions and strategic brand engagement. We specialize in Film Promotion & Celebrity PR, Google 360° VR Property Publishing, Financial Services Distribution, and B2B Commercial Sales.

## Company Information

- **Founded:** Thane West, Maharashtra, India
- **Address:** 2nd Floor, 227-228, Wardhaman Industrial Estate, Gokul Nagar, Thane West - 400601, Maharashtra, India
- **Phone:** +91 93244 83283
- **Email:** contact@erosinc.in
- **Website:** https://erosinc.in

## Core Business Divisions

### Google 360° VR Property Publishing
HDR 360° virtual tours, Google Street View integration, and local SEO boosting for real estate, hospitality, and retail businesses.
- URL: https://erosinc.in/businesses/google-360

### Financial Services Distribution
Retail banking growth, credit card acquisitions, and verified KYC compliance through direct sales channels.
- URL: https://erosinc.in/businesses/financial-services

### Film Promotion & Celebrity PR
Film launch campaigns, celebrity PR, media press relations, red carpet events, and brand endorsements across Bollywood and Indian cinema.
- URL: https://erosinc.in/businesses/film-promotions

### B2B Commercial Sales
Enterprise account acceleration, B2B sales negotiation, and channel partner expansion.
- URL: https://erosinc.in/businesses/b2b-commercial
